description: This Java class, `GlobalConfigurationHelper`, provides helper methods for managing global configurations in the Fineract system, including enabling, disabling, setting string values, and retrieving configurations via API calls.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for testing and managing global configuration settings in Fineract through API calls. It can enable, disable, set string values, and retrieve configuration data.

methods.name: disableGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Disables a global configuration identified by `configKey` and sets its value.

methods.name: enableGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Enables a global configuration identified by `configKey` and sets its value.

methods.name: switchAndSetGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve a configuration, update its enabled status and value, and verify the update.

methods.name: setGlobalConfigValueString
methods.description: Sets a string value for a global configuration, ensuring it is enabled.

methods.name: getGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration data for a given `configKey`.
